turns.text: Because I told you I'm still figuring things out.
turns.zh: 因为我说过，我还在慢慢想清楚。

turns.text: Well, partly, yes, but I'm not here to pressure you.
turns.zh: 嗯，有一部分是，但我不是来给你压力的。

turns.text: I just want to understand what you're thinking these days.
turns.zh: 我只是想了解你最近在想什么。

turns.text: It's been almost a year since you graduated.
I know, and I appreciate that you've been patient with me.
turns.zh: 我知道，我也很感激你一直对我这么有耐心。

turns.text: Honestly, I'm still not sure what direction I want to go in.
turns.zh: 说实话，我到现在也还不确定自己想往哪个方向走。
